text:
sara-support: Heads up — Customer ACME reported sustained 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference since ~10:12 PST. Spike in gateway 504s, lots of tail latency. Escalating to infra.

oncall-bot: Alert: High 5xx rate detected on tenant acme-app (gateway) — 10:12 -> now. Incident channel created.

mike-sre: Looking. Can someone paste a sample request id and recent gateway logs?

sara-support: req=6f2a9c, customer says requests hang for ~25s then 504. Billing/auth looks OK (token accepted). Dropped traces: https://internal.logs/r/6f2a9c

lina-ml: Quick glance: backend reports model-init delays and many pods stuck in Init:ImagePull or not Ready. KEDA scaling events around 10:10-10:20 with low activation.

ryan-platform: I see HPA desired=0 -> 3 -> 0 flapping for that tenant; KEDAScaledObject has trigger threshold at 75 queue depth, but queue jumped to 200 briefly. KEDA configured cooldown=300s which prevented faster reactivation.

mike-sre: That explains scale-up lag. Also readinessProbe has initialDelaySeconds=20 and startupProbe disabled. Cold pods take ~18s to become ready plus model load ~6s. Combined > timeout.

sara-support: Customer is on hosted inference (shared pools). Could we failover to smaller warm pool or serve degraded model while nodes warm?

ops-svcs: Immediate mitigation: bumped minReplicas for acme-app to 2 in dedicated pool and forced a prewarm on one node. Also lowered KEDA cooldown to 60s for the tenant as a stopgap.

lina-ml: Repro steps I ran in staging: 1) flood 50 concurrent small requests 2) scale down minReplica=0 3) observe KEDA activation delay with cooldown=300. Logs: 
```
ScaledObject acme-scaledobject: lastScaleTime=2026-03-17T10:11:22Z
KEDA: metrics: queueLength=210, activationThreshold=75, cooldown=300s
HPA: desiredReplicas=0->3 (observed=0 for 35s)
runtime: model load time=6.4s, container start=16s, readiness attach=20s
```

mike-sre: Suggested immediate fixes: set minReplicas>=1 for any tenant with >N qps (apply per-tenant policy), enable startupProbe to detect container init early, add prewarm hook (model cache warm) in scaledown path. Also add KEDA activation tuning: lower cooldown for bursty tenants and/or enable warm standby.

ryan-platform: Filed infra ticket INF-6842 to add per-tenant scaling profile options and warm-standby feature.

alex-customer-suc: Communicated mitigations to ACME: temporary degraded model fallback and extended timeouts. Customer accepts workaround but requests SLA credit for the outage window.

sara-support: Action items: 1) Short-term: keep minReplicas=2 for acme-app until policy rolled out (done). 2) Mid-term: INF-6842 (scaling profiles + warm standby). 3) Add automation to detect KEDA cooldown mismatch alerts and auto-tune based on observed queue spike. 4) Postmortem draft assigned to mike-sre and lina-ml.

mike-sre: Assigning postmortem — will include timeline, repro, config diffs and recommended k8s changes.

lina-ml: Also add test cases to eval harness to simulate cold starts + queue bursts so we catch regressions.

sara-support: Thanks everyone. I'll keep ACME updated. :thumbsup:
